style.checked_requirement: Assigned schedule-led public notice: left participation information and right yellow title/photo/footer; flat Gothic typography and natural-light local interior.
style.observation: Dark teal left information panel; pale yellow right event identity and footer; realistic eye-level community photo; title heavier than assigned emphasis at thumbnail size.
plan_differences: Date/time begins lower than the right title; right title is larger in relation to schedule than the planned sketch. Participation information remains in the prescribed left grouping.

single_flat_opaque.observation: One flat landscape poster with continuous filled panels and rectangular photo; no mockup, contact sheet or transparent cutout is visible. Tool argument transparent_background=false.

substantive_visual.observation: Architecture/light photographs, actual window light and adults listening to a guide form the content-grounded visual relation.

hangul.observation: Syllable proportions, counters and interword spaces remain readable in native and usage views. No missing or ambiguous Hangul glyph was observed.

information_relationship.observation: Date/time to venue to admission/cost/application runs down the left. Title to event descriptor to shared exhibition/talk scene to visit/welcome lines runs down the right; the split connects one event.

function_contact.reason: No handling/mechanical action, URL, QR or contact method was requested; no unsupported contact information was added.

local_material_edges.observation: Clean panel borders and type edges; coherent window/floor/wall perspective in the photograph. Small photographed faces and fingers are not individually detailed at usage720.

real_building_identity.observation: An anonymous ordinary interior is shown; no identifiable landmark, institutional logo or promotional signage was observed.

observations.observation: A glazed window, sunlit wood floor, framed architecture/light photographs and an adult group listening to a gesturing guide share one interior and perspective; the exhibition and talk are visibly linked.
The date and time form the largest left block; the venue is directly below, followed by three aligned entry/cost/application lines. All participation information can be read in a downward scan.

Bold flat sans serif forms have closed Hangul syllable shapes, discernible counters and intact word spaces. Date dots, time colons, the centered long time dash and the three middle-dot separators remain visible.

observations.location: vertical split and right photo edges
observations.observation: The left dark panel and right yellow panel form a clean vertical split. Right title, descriptor and footer share an inset alignment; the photo reaches the right edge. No text crosses into the photograph.

observations.location: right photo window, frames and people
observations.observation: Natural light reaches the floor and wall; picture frames follow the wall perspective. Adults face the guide/photographs. Bodies and major limbs remain individually readable, with minor finger detail small in the scene.
Ordinary adult clothing, relaxed listening and a bright local room support an approachable community event; strong contrast makes the notice direct.
There are no logos, QR codes, captions, fake tiny text, tape pieces or decorative blobs. The substantive room scene carries the event content.

The large right title is the strongest single glyph mass and competes with the left date/time. The split still offers an immediate schedule entry point on the left and event identity/photo on the right.

residuals.location: upper right title versus upper left date/time
residuals.observation: The Korean title is the strongest single text mass and competes with the intended date-first emphasis.

residuals.location: right photo adult faces and guide hand
residuals.observation: Faces and fingers are small photographic details; the listening relation is visible but fine anatomy is limited at this display size.

selection_reason: The initial result retains every copy line, readable participation information and a coherent exhibition/talk scene. The remaining hierarchy variation does not obstruct information retrieval; no repair is justified solely to match sketch coordinates.
